يرتقبون (form VIII)
# يَرْتَقِبُونَ (yartaqibūna) /jar.ta.qi.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# يُرْتَقَبُونَ (yurtaqabūna) /jur.ta.qa.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
